profile.headline: Senior R&D Software Engineer at Keysight Technologies
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer in the electronic test and measurement industry. Comfortable working at the application layer, all the way down to embedded firmware.

positions.title: Senior R&D Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer for the backend of Keysight's mid & high-performance spectrum analyzer lines.

positions.title: R&D Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Release lead for Network Analyzer firmware
- hardware control software for network analyzer platforms in C++
- embedded firmware for test & measurement accessories in C
- automated functional tests for application code, embedded systems, and FPGA designs in Python
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), C (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: R&D Firmware Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed functional tests in C# for the testing of the UXG signal source platform.

positions.title: NREIP Intern
positions.description: Reverse-engineered a decommissioned software system developed by a defense contractor to track the repair of naval missiles at their depot. This entailed analyzing their applications that spanned 3 servers, getting them to run in a virtual environment, and providing this to the Navy to extract the data.

company.name: Naval Surface Warfare Center, Corona Division

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed a web-based survey for a study on Mexican politicians in English and Spanish. 
Maintained website content and performed general IT services for the Departments of Economics and Political Science.
